consequence.statement: After upgrading to 1.13, policy exceptions are disabled by default and only allowed in a specified namespace, so environments that relied on the prior default (exceptions allowed in all namespaces) have their existing PolicyException resources no longer honoured and previously-excepted resources become subject to policy enforcement again unless the operator follows the upgrade guidance.
consequence.remediation: Follow the Kyverno 1.13 upgrade guidance to explicitly re-enable policy exceptions, now restricted to a specified namespace, instead of relying on the previous defaults.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 changes the defaults so that policy exceptions are disabled and only allowed in a specified namespace (previously allowed in all namespaces, see CVE-2024-48921); environments relying on the old default must follow the upgrade guidance to keep exceptions working.
